liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Martin Fierro keeps horn noise minimal at the end of Eyes Of The World; Eyes Of The World is much better than the performance on September 17, 1973 [5][8]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider is the highlight of the first set [4]

## The recordings

- **gd73-09-20.aud-sbd.cotsman.11618.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 133 min; rated 3.75/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: The audience recording quality is poor, and the soundboard recording is also not good; The first set is mono audience, while the rest is a great sounding SBD [3][4]
- **gd1973-09-20.sbd.clugston.9845.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 69 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [2]

## Around the show

- This was the first of a two-night run that fall [7]
- James Panko, a former Chicago trombonist, was staying at the uploader's hotel [12]
- The second set was unusually short for 1973, and the band was tight but not inspired [7]
- The September 21 show is considered one of the best of the year [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-09-20.aud-sbd.cotsman.11618.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience Composite [1]. Also: The recording was mixed from audience and soundboard sources via Michael Dixon and Scott Clugston [1]
- **gd1973-09-20.sbd.clugston.9845.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Re-Mastering by Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Reel > Reel to Reel > PCM > CDR [2]
